**Finding submitted: ASSIGN — deviation (fallback target).**

- **Responsive language:** only § 14.1 (p0121). Searches for "change of control", "terminate this Agreement" and all "assign" hits confirmed no Vendor termination or re-pricing trigger on Corio's change of control (§ 11.1–11.2 cover non-renewal, breach and insolvency only), and no separate no-consent affiliate exception that would conflict with the fallback.
- **What already meets fallback:** mutual successor assignment right (merger/acquisition/sale of substantially all assets) and a consent requirement for all other assignments.
- **What failed:** no "not unreasonably withheld" standard (acute given the "direct competitor" consent limb) and no written notice for successor assignments.
- **Cure:** two surgical inserts into § 14.1 preserving all other wording; minimality gate returned ok:true.
